details.description: Pale grey slightly warm concrete forms the whole field.
Regular saw-cut joints form four square2m bays across each8m axis.
Narrow dark joint centres have softer grey shoulders.
Fine shallow broom and finishing strokes are visible within individual bays.
Concrete bays vary subtly in lightness and warmth.
Faint cloudy cement mottling runs through the pale surface.
Small mineral speckles remain visible at close range.
Sparse small darker stains interrupt a few bay faces.
Very fine isolated line marks and scratches occur on some bays.

All required checks and installed parity pass; reviewed whole-asset quality exceeds95.

authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
